review: Fresh independent original2017 source/key, exact-asked-scope and coverage-stopping review

independence.scope: Original2017 base/core all nine species, including Faderan reverse, accepted original printed components and direct contemporaneous designer rulings. No Remastered, expansions or optional variants.

source_key_findings.problem: The expected answer and required atom say jungle colony. The actual original booklet p2 relic-deck converter depicts the white snowflake climate icon (ice), not the green jungle/seedling icon. The four small white cubes are correct.

source_evidence.location: How Cards Enter Play, bottom deck-symbol converter illustration
Balkanized States’ Colonies illustration: entry uses white snowflake and barren icons; bottom upgrade uses distinct green jungle icon

minimal_fix.question_wording: Keep Q36 unchanged; it already asks exact illustrated inputs.
minimal_fix.answer_key_expected_answer: Four small white cubes and one colony bearing the depicted white snowflake/ice climate icon; the consumed ordinary colony goes beneath the colony deck.

required_fact_replacement.fact: One colony with the depicted white snowflake/ice climate icon

sync: current-coverage-map.json Faderan relic-deck cost source unit: replace jungle with the depicted snowflake/ice climate

source_key_findings.effect: This is a source-truth correction to an already asked cost atom, not a request to widen Q36.

notes: Q02/Q10/Q12/Q38/Q41/Q53 concrete outcomes do not require separately narrated formulas or methods.
Q13 does not need the unchanged third token narrated; required moved tokens and points suffice.
Q37 loan permission does not separately ask numeric support; Q42 asks who receives rewards, not ordinary printed reward quantities.
Q78’s positive permission is the required atom; its gift prohibition remains valid context and is separately asked in Q49.
Do not widen existing questions to fix CV-01.

coverage_stopping_findings.source_unit: Kjas original territory illustration: permission to run both separate economic converters on the same tile

source_evidence.location: Balkanized States’ Colonies illustrated tile, between its two white converters

coverage_stopping_findings.why_current_questions_do_not_test_it: Q45 asks the top entry and bottom upgrade converters, card treatment, initial status and loans; its required facts never ask whether both middle economic converters may run. Q06 asks whether one converter may run twice, its optionality and chaining; it does not test the distinct permission to activate two separate converters on one physical card/tile. Q33 is a seeded single-converter repeat exception, not this permission.
coverage_stopping_findings.why_novel: The source expressly grants both-activation permission. This changes a legal production choice and tests the unit of the activation limit (converter versus card/tile). It is neither another card-output quantity nor a cosmetic renaming of an already asked one-converter outcome.

proposed_question.question: An in-play Kjasjavikalimm territory tile has two separate white economic converters, and its holder has enough pre-Economy inputs to pay for both. May the holder run both converters in that Economy, or must they choose only one converter for the tile?
proposed_question.expected_answer: The holder may run both separate economic converters in that Economy; there is no one-converter-per-tile choice restriction.

required_facts.fact: Both separate economic converters on the territory tile may run during the same Economy when their inputs are available.

contextual_background: Each individual converter is still limited to one run, and the outputs are simultaneous. These are correct explanations, not additional omission criteria for this permission question.
source_references: Original Kjasjavikalimm front, Balkanized States’ Colonies illustration: YOU MAY RUN BOTH CONVERTERS.
Original booklet p7: each economic converter at most once per turn.

coverage_stopping_findings.repair_scope: Add this new question/key/asked atom and map its actual asked permission. Do not expand Q45 to rescue unasked coverage. Then rewalk sources for stopping again.

stopping_decision.reason: One expressly printed consequential positive permission remains untested (CV-01); additionally correct the already-asked source error SK-01. No quota or target question count was imposed.

source_rewalk.unit: Booklet pp1–2 components, privacy, interchangeable ships, entry symbols, card ownership and shortages
Booklet pp3–5 setup, deck randomization, era stacking, track counts and first phase
source_rewalk.challenge: Initial colony/research lowest-minimum-up dealing is the same source-defined track-deal procedure; merely swapping the deck name is not a new outcome branch.

source_rewalk.unit: Booklet p6 simultaneous play, trade assent/binding promises, accepted/rejected compensation, invention and upgrade routes
Booklet p7 support check, no-input/optional/once economic converters, no chaining, donations, wilds, climate and colony cycling
source_rewalk.decision: covered except CV-01 positive multi-converter permission from original species illustration

source_rewalk.unit: Booklet p8 sharing, bid commitment, ranks, relevant-card ties, retained-pile concealment, negotiation and cleanup
Booklet p9 ordinary turn advancement and final scoring; direct2017 designer final phase/theft clarification; printed final bonus bands
source_rewalk.challenge: Concrete scoring groups exercise group rates without separately demanding a narrated formula. Optional precise fractions and closing designer house-rule suggestion are excluded.
Mixed colored/wild and all-wild outcomes cover the genuinely distinct output-color branches; the physical slide method is not an extra gate.

source_rewalk.unit: Faderan front and complete reverse; accepted printed original relic cards
source_rewalk.challenge: All eight reverse-sheet special procedures checked. Additional plain entry rewards, production quantities, changed Cache numbers, or fresh-ship no-chaining examples do not justify additional questions.

source_rewalk.unit: Kjasjavikalimm complete original rules and pictured original territory tile
source_rewalk.challenge: Even/odd split number substitutions are not new. The expressly printed permission to run both economic converters remains unasked.

source_rewalk.unit: Zeth complete original rules and official final-turn clarification
source_rewalk.challenge: Positive stash trade, prohibition on gifts/circulation, same-recipient token bundle, target-specific envoy discount, gift-vs-trade protection, shortage and size/color restrictions all actually asked. No unsupported last-envoy ruling added.

rejected_new_candidate_classes: Cosmetic species/player names or bid/Cache/scoring number changes
Ordinary card input/output or entry quantities beyond the already asked cases
A separate Transmutive Decomposer no-chaining question
A separate physical slide/arrangement or remaining-token recital
Initial colony-track dealing as a mere deck-name substitution of the tested initial track-deal method
Unasked explanatory formulas treated as extra omission gates
Optional precise scoring/timed trades/handicapping, later editions and expansions
Speculative final Envoys-token or simultaneous-impossible-promise rulings not resolved in original authorities
